authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The whole progressive is the tṛṣā thirst family + be felt + remain + is. Turner 5936 explicitly includes Hindi tis and tisāyā alongside the noun; 10895 supplies lag-, 10666 rah-, and 1031 the h-present copula. The expanded tisāī/tisāyī is retained as part of the first lexical constituent.
